_meta.description: Remap of removed DRG-mod prefab refs -> current equivalents. Grouped Category > Faction > FactionKey > Type for manual reading. Key = OLD full ref {GUID}Path.et, value = NEW full ref. Empty value = stub awaiting a replacement; the restore script applies only filled entries and skips/flags stubs. Grouping keys (Characters, OPFOR, RHS_AFRF, ...) are ignored by the script.
